brief.about: Animation-clock test fixture. Two scenes; scene 1 has a 2.5s-delayed CSS animation the renderer used to drop.

narrative.logline: A fixture proves delayed CSS animations survive the MP4 render.
narrative.arc: Open on the control, close on the delayed payoff.

scenes.label: Scene zero
scenes.description: Immediate text so a black frame is distinguishable from a working render.
scenes.visual_concept: Composition: centered headline on black. Animations: headline clockFade at 0.2s duration 0.4s.

scenes.label: Delayed payoff
scenes.description: Control text at 0.3s delay, payoff text at 2.5s delay — the dropped case.
scenes.visual_concept: Composition: control text top band, payoff headline centered. Animations: control clockFade at 0.3s duration 0.4s; payoff clockFade at 2.5s duration 0.5s.
